description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It manages the main home screen UI, including a hero banner carousel, Continue Watching and TV Channels rails, focus navigation handling, auto-scrolling of the hero carousel, and integration with ViewModel and Repository patterns for data loading. The fragment builds a complex focusable UI layout with custom focus routing and D-pad navigation behavior suitable for an Android TV environment.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing the home screen, including hero carousel, content rails, focus navigation, and data loading.
